ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across visible surfaces; high contrast concentrated on the left lobe ventral region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region extending from the mid-section to the lateral tip, bisected by a prominent vertical low-intensity linear feature. Right lobe exhibits dominant low-intensity black pigmentation with localized high-intensity stippling at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees; apex is sharply defined at the central junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude irregular serrations with three distinct primary peaks. Right lobe trailing edge shows finer, low-amplitude micro-serrations, partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary lobes follow a convex sweep trajectory extending laterally and posteriorly from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular pixel clusters (grey-white) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear low-intensity mark on the left lobe; multiple smaller horizontal low-intensity scratches visible within the white high-intensity zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular calcified-looking clusters on the terminal edges of both lobes suggesting significant surface colonization; noticeable jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, thick vertical black pigment line or scar running perpendicular to the trailing edge on the left ventral surface.
